target_statement: Construction of the pointed Gromov-Hausdorff transport interface that mathlib's unpointed GHSpace API lacks. (1) Coupling-space point-transport lemma: for compact nonempty metric X, Y with ghDist X Y < r and x : X, there exists y : Y with dist (optimalGHInjl X Y x) (optimalGHInjr X Y y) < r. (2) A pointed family structure carrying the explicit compatible-coupling data (coupling spaces, isometric embeddings, rate eps -> 0, Hausdorff compatibility, basepoint compatibility), the basepoint-convergence assembly conditional on that data, and the D12-consuming assembly that constructs the data from unpointed compactness with the basepoints as data.

classification.proved_metric_level: Part (1) point transport (all 8 transport lemmas) and the sharp attained-infimum form; also the D12-consuming assemblies pointed_subseq_of_familyBounds / pointed_subseq_of_compact / pointed_coupling_of_tendsto, which construct the explicit pointed data from D12's proved unpointed subsequence theorems plus compactness of the limit.
classification.conditional_on_explicit_pointed_data: PointedGHCoupling.pointed_convergence / ghDist_tendsto / basepoint_tendsto are conditional on the explicit coupling certificate (the structure is their hypothesis). This is the precise sense in which the pointed statement is data-conditional: unpointed ghDist convergence alone constrains no basepoint. NOTE: the data is not merely assumed in the compact setting -- pointed_subseq_of_* construct it from D12's unpointed hypotheses.
classification.not_claimed: No geometric (Cheeger-Gromov / Bishop-Gromov / kappa-noncollapsing / harmonic-coordinate) input is supplied or consumed: D12's statement-only Props are untouched. No Poincare / Ricci-flow statement is made.
